widgets_values: The image is a digital illustration of a heart-shaped pendant. The pendant is made up of multiple small, round, pink and black stones arranged in a symmetrical pattern. The stones are of different sizes and shapes, with some being larger and others being smaller. The heart is in the center of the pendant, with a larger pink stone in the middle and smaller black stones on either side. Above the heart, there is a silver ribbon-like design that is attached to the top. The background is white, making the colors of the stones stand out. The overall design is elegant and sophisticated.
